about: Police and FIR: stops and refers to a lawyer and free legal aid, with no extraction or legal answer.

sent.text: Police called me and said an FIR has been filed against me for cheating by my old employer. What should I do?

assistant.content: This involves a possible criminal case, the police, which needs a real lawyer, not an app. Please don't rely on me for this part. If cost is a concern, call the free legal aid helpline 15100 or visit your District Legal Services Authority.

citations.title: Free legal aid
citations.caveat: The income limit varies by state.
citations.summary: Women, children, members of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, persons with disabilities, industrial workmen, people in custody and people below the income limit can get a free lawyer. Call the NALSA helpline 15100 or visit your District Legal Services Authority.
